about.en: ELF is the native coin of aelf, a Layer 1 blockchain founded in 2017 and based in Singapore, built in C# around a main chain with side chains and promoted as an AI-oriented smart-contract platform. ELF pays transaction fees and is staked to elect the network's block producers; an ERC-20 version (0xbf2179859fc6D5BEE9Bf9158632Dc51678a4100e) circulates on Ethereum alongside the native coin.
